**🔴 I told you:** Dark money groups have now poured in over $2.6 MILLION to boost my opponents.
**🔴 I told you:** One of my opponents has been hammering the airwaves with ads for WEEKS, and another is going live imminently.
**🔴 And now, I'm telling you: **My first TV ad JUST went live, and**** if I can't raise another $250,000 today to help close the gap, we won't be able to keep our new ad on air for long.
#### **[Please, don't make me beg. I hate asking you for money, but I refuse to take a CENT of corporate PAC money. I just need 3 more local Democrats to step up today. Can I count on you to chip in $5 to help close the gap? >>](https://substack.com/redirect/9376ac4f-410f-4621-a6ad-5a06338ea000?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Here's the honest truth.
In 2024, I ran for Congress in Maryland, and I fought as hard as I possibly could.
But dark money groups spent **MILLIONS** of dollars to drown me out, and it worked.
I watched it happen in real time: ads I couldn't match, mailers I couldn't answer, and a wall of money between me and the voters I was trying to reach.
When you have the kind of money my opponents do, you don't have to win the argument. **You just have to make sure the other side can 't be heard.**
That's why it's so incredibly important to fund this latest ad buy so that I can fight back and show my opponents that our grassroots momentum is nothing to laugh at.
I know that I can win this race. But I can't win it if I can't keep my ads on air and show every single voter in Maryland's 5th Congressional District why they need to send me to Congress.

name: Roy Cooper (via Cooper Victory Fund)
subject: A long email but one worth reading
body:
Starting to remind me a lot of my 2016 race.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=1544%2E124072%2EcEGtD_)
| | | |
---
Peter,
At the end of this message, I’m going to ask you to chip in $5 to my Senate campaign here in North Carolina. **[If you’re ready to give now, you can use this link to donate.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11936?amount=5&t=8&akid=1544%2E124072%2EcEGtD_)**
**Otherwise, please let me explain why your support is so important and what could happen without it.**
In 2016, I ran for Governor for the first time.
I was fighting to unseat Republican Governor Pat McCrory. Nobody had defeated an incumbent Governor in North Carolina for more than 150 years, but I knew that we had the team behind us to win and make history.
Throughout the race, multiple election experts were saying it was a “Toss Up.” Poll after poll showed me with a slight – or sometimes even large – lead. The momentum was on our side.
**However, on election night, the race was too close to call.**
I ended that night with a less than 5,000-vote lead – which might sound like a lot but is a razor-thin margin in North Carolina, especially given the 4.6 million ballots cast. It was less than half of 1%.
Governor McCrory didn’t concede. He claimed that there had been voter fraud in our state with no evidence to back it up.
He called for a recount, and over the next month, he and his team continued spreading baseless conspiracy theories and undermining faith in the democratic process.
**Yet on Dec. 5, 2016, democracy won. The recount was wrapped up, and the results were in: We had won the race by 10,277 votes.**
Peter, this current Senate race is starting to remind me a lot of my 2016 race.
Just like in 2016, the momentum today appears to be on our side.
Experts are calling this race a “Toss Up.” Even though President Trump carried North Carolina each of the three times he ran, recent polling shows me statistically tied with his handpicked candidate. Even the experts are saying that this is the best chance for Democrats to flip a Republican-held seat in the country.
Here’s what worries me...
**We could have just as easily lost that race in 2016. Despite all of the winds blowing in our favor, we still only won by 10,277 votes – just 0.22%.**
That’s why we simply cannot take our foot off the gas. We cannot look at the polls and the predictions and think for a second that we have this in the bag. We cannot give our Republican opponent or the right-wing super PACs supporting him an inch.
**I won in 2016 – in the same election that President Trump first won the presidency – only because of grassroots support from people like you. That’s how I plan to win again, but I need you with me.**
[**Please, Peter: Will you chip in $5, or whatever you can, today to help us flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate for Democrats?**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11936?amount=5&t=9&akid=1544%2E124072%2EcEGtD_)
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11937?amount=5&t=10&akid=1544%2E124072%2EcEGtD_)
---

---
| | [DONATE ANOTHER AMOUNT](https://act.roycooper.com/go/11938?t=13&akid=1544%2E124072%2EcEGtD_)
---
Thank you for reading. I appreciate it.

Roy Cooper
| |
* * *
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/8188?t=2&akid=1544%2E124072%2EcEGtD_)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

name: Elise Stefanik
subject: I’ll come right out and say it…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Team Elise, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and composed of E-PAC and Save New York
body:
Our efforts are falling short.
| Peter,
---
The latest polling is setting off alarm bells in GOP headquarters – _and for good reason_!
---
**_Democrats hold 6-point advantage in battleground districts: Poll_**
[Source: _The Hill_]
---
You read that right: Democrats now **LEAD** by **_6 POINTS_** on the generic ballot in battleground districts with only a few months to go until the midterm elections begin!
---
**I’ve always been honest with you, so I’ll come right out and say it: Our voter verification efforts are falling short.__IF__ this polling holds, President Trump’s Majority is as good as __GONE__. **
---
Far Left Democrats will seize power in the people’s House and take control of committee gavels, the power of the purse, impeachment powers, and they’ll use it all to go after the President and his supporters.
---
Remember, they were willing to throw President Trump in JAIL as an innocent man just to win an election. __These radicals will stop at NOTHING to DESTROY MAGA!__
---
But there’s one MAJOR silver lining...
---
**We still have enough time to close this 6-point gap by verifying thousands of reliable Republican voters who are still marked as “UNVERIFIED” in our system.**
---
At the end of the day, the GOP has the numbers advantage: If all of our voters turn out and cast a ballot, we WILL defy history and win the midterms!
---

August 8, 2009, is a date I will never forget.
Just days before his 19th birthday, my son Justin was out in the fields with us, doing what this family has done for over three generations—farming the Louisiana delta. A breakdown in our combine left corn spilled across the ground, and as we worked to recover it, Justin got too close. In an instant, his pant leg was caught, and the thresher pulled him in.
I can still hear his voice: “Dad, get me out.”
And there was nothing I could do.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
Multiple miracles occurred that day: When it initially happened he wasn’t in pain because his nerves were pinched so tightly in the machine. Nor was he bleeding because he was caught so tight in there.
It took the jaws of life to tear apart that machine and when the metal finally gave way he let out a scream that I will never forget for the rest of my life.
The paramedics quickly sprang into action and he was airlifted to Jackson, Mississippi, where Doctors fought to save his leg, but the injury and infection from all the dirt and debris were too severe. Justin lost his leg from below the knee.
That day could have broken us. Instead, it showed me what makes Louisiana strong.
Neighbors, first responders from two parishes (what we call counties in Louisiana), and a doctor who wasn’t even on duty, Dr. Ron Gregg, a farmer himself and longtime family friend — showed up because that’s what rural communities do. They take care of each other. They don’t ask if it’s their job or jurisdiction. They just show up.
Today, Justin is 35. He runs our farm. He’s built a life, with a fiancée and a family of his own. He still hunts, fishes, and works the land — just with a prosthetic leg and the same determination that carried him through that day.
But the truth is, the kind of community that saved Justin is disappearing. Rural hospitals are closing. Doctors like Dr. Gregg—who live in our communities, who know our families—are harder to find. Too many of our kids feel like they have to leave home to build a future.
And my family, who first worked this Louisiana delta soil as slaves and sharecroppers, and now as farmers who own this land, have put too much blood into this soil for us to leave and go somewhere else.
I have to take a stand and fight for our way of life and it’s why I am proud to be the Democrat running for Senate in Louisiana.
If you believe in that fight, I’m asking you to stand with me today. A Democratic win here is the first step in taking our state back from the far-right whose policies of atomization and vicious corporatism are tearing our communities apart.
And mark my words, a win is possible, Democrats just won a deep red special election here by a landslide. The blue wave will wash over Louisiana and we will flip this seat but only if we fight for it. Will you please make a contribution of $50, $20, or even just $10 to help us in our fight to restore the Louisiana that we love so dearly. The American people have completely lost faith in our federal government, and honestly, can you blame them? Washington has turned into a playground for the wealthy and well-connected. Members of Congress spend half their days fundraising from elite corporate donors and the other half trading stocks based on confidential committee information.
My name is Mike Cortese. I am running for Congress in TN-04 and my diagnosis is simple: the system is fundamentally broken, and it's because career politicians have zero incentive to fix a system that**makes them rich.**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/566aea6e-75f4-4e4c-b5c4-bbb47bbd118f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Help us clean up Washington.[Chip in $25 today to fund our fight for true government accountability.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/7809b4de-a57a-44ad-9141-e0adad582575?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[It all starts HERE! Join Today!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/7809b4de-a57a-44ad-9141-e0adad582575?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I believe public service is a temporary sacrifice, not a lifetime career. On the Metro Council, transparency and strict ethical adherence aren't optional, they are expected. **We need to bring that exact same standard to the federal government.**
When I am elected to represent the 4th District, I will fight for structural reforms: banning members of Congress from trading individual stocks, overturning _Citizens United_ to get dark money out of our politics, and implementing strict ethics rules for representatives and lobbyists alike.
If we want to change Washington, we have to change the types of people we send there. I am running a transparent, people-powered campaign. subject: An insider NM poll just landed
body:
Plus: Trump's approval just hit a number no president has held in 17 years. | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/ZmaWSH1bXLC?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
An insider poll just landed on our desk. It covered the biggest races in New Mexico. The results aren't what people expect.
[We had the pollster on to break it all down — and tell us who actually wins.](https://us.list-manage.com/16HwgmWQK97?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/ROEdmHJhwOv?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
🔥 **INSIDER POLL: GREGG HULL 33, DOUG TURNER 30, DUKE RODRIGUEZ 12 — 25% UNDECIDED**
Nicole McCleskey of Public Opinion Strategies — the pollster behind Susana Martinez and 13 gubernatorial races in 2022 — joined us with her husband Jay, one of New Mexico's top GOP strategists, to break down the numbers on Gregg Hull, Doug Turner, and Duke Rodriguez.
The horse race number tells one story. The favorability numbers tell a completely different one. And there's a specific stat about Duke that tells you why he can't win this race no matter what he does from here.
Then she made her call. Jay did too. One person at our table didn't agree — and you'll never guess who.

🚨 **HULL'S CAMPAIGN HAS A PROBLEM. SO DOES TURNER.**
Turner is attacking. Hull is not responding. That math doesn't end well in any campaign we've ever seen.
The regional breakdown is even more revealing. There's one part of New Mexico where Turner is up 30 points on Hull. There's another part where Hull is up 27. We show you the map.
If Hull doesn't change something fast, the pollster says this could be a 20-point race. The wrong direction.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/4FiTVRfvFqO?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
📉 **TRUMP'S APPROVAL JUST HIT A NUMBER NO PRESIDENT HAS SEEN IN 17 YEARS**
37%. The NYT/Siena poll just dropped, and it's the lowest second-term number in nearly two decades. Underwater on immigration — his strongest issue a year ago. Underwater on cost of living. Underwater everywhere.
What that means for whoever wins the Republican primary in New Mexico is the conversation every campaign in the country is having right now. We had it on the show.

⛽ **DEB HAALAND TRIED TO ANSWER A FRACKING QUESTION. IT DIDN'T GO WELL.**
KRQE's Jessica Garate asked a yes-or-no question. The former Interior Secretary couldn't get there. Then Jessica asked a follow-up.
When you see what banning fracking on public lands actually means for New Mexico schools, you'll understand why she didn't want to answer the first time.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://us.list-manage.com/18uGDH9x8zx?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
PLUS: Trump just endorsed Ken Paxton in Texas — but the Democrat, James Talarico, is polling at 44%. The best number a Texas Democrat has hit for Senate since 2002. We break down what that does to the Republican Senate map.

Friend, we're down to the wire. Before I ask you to **_[make an urgent donation to help my campaign in the last 7 days,](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/8175?refcode=jtk793-fr-nd&t=2&akid=9885%2E400544%2EhLUDjr)_** I'd like to share how I got here and what I am fighting for.
I am the proud descendant of generations of fierce Pueblo women. Their strength and resilience gave me the courage to run for office and fight for New Mexicans, including standing up to Donald Trump.
**I made history as one of the first Native American women elected to Congress and then the first Native American Cabinet Secretary in U.S. history. And _when_ we win this race, I will be the first Native American woman elected Governor in any state. **
**But for me, this work has never been about titles or being the first.**
It’s about fighting for working families, standing up for New Mexicans, and making sure more people have a seat at the table. I want to leave the ladder down for the next generation of leaders and build a government that truly reflects and fights for the people it serves. Higher wages. Lower costs. Stronger education so our kids can read earlier. Protecting and expanding access to healthcare in every part of New Mexico so you can see a doctor even when you’re not sick. Investing in mental and behavioral healthcare, substance use treatments and rehabilitation, and housing stability so we can make our communities safer.
__**That's just a quick look into my vision for the future of New Mexico and our country, and now, I'm asking you to invest in it. I truly believe there's nothing we can't accomplish if we work together, and with thousands of New Mexicans already casting their ballots, I need you with me now more than ever._[So please, friend, can I count on you to chip in $5 or more before the June 2 primary to help me fight for working families, deliver real progress for New Mexicans, and leave the ladder down for the next generation of leaders?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/8175?refcode=jtk793-fr-nd&t=3&akid=9885%2E400544%2EhLUDjr)_**

clean_body: | | | | Friend, we're down to the wire. Before I ask you to I'd like to share how I got here and what I am fighting for. I am the proud descendant of generations of fierce Pueblo women. Their strength and resilience gave me the courage to run for office and fight for New Mexicans, including standing up to Donald Trump. I made history as one of the first Native American women elected to Congress and then the first Native American Cabinet Secretary in U.S. history. And when we win this race, I will be the first Native American woman elected Governor in any state. But for me, this work has never been about titles or being the first. It’s about fighting for working families, standing up for New Mexicans, and making sure more people have a seat at the table. I want to leave the ladder down for the next generation of leaders and build a government that truly reflects and fights for the people it serves. Higher wages. Lower costs. Stronger education so our kids can read earlier. Protecting and expanding access to healthcare in every part of New Mexico so you can see a doctor even when you’re not sick. Investing in mental and behavioral healthcare, substance use treatments and rehabilitation, and housing stability so we can make our communities safer. That's just a quick look into my vision for the future of New Mexico and our country, and now, I'm asking you to invest in it. body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cdp-footer?refcode=header&amount=5 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cdp-footer?refcode=header&amount=5]
Dear friends,
I recently had the pleasure of hosting an Instagram Live chat [https://www.instagram.com/reels/DYn1f9OiYIC/] with my good friend and South Asian community leader Harini Krishnan to celebrate Asian American, Native Hawaiian and Pacific Islander Heritage Month. She shared that, to her, this month celebrates the AANHPI pioneers that have shaped US history.
I totally agree – and the pioneers that came to mind were my grandparents.
All four of them – Alfonso and Vivencia Vanderlipe & Quintin and Fausta Ramil – immigrated from the Philippines (each with seven kids in tow!) to give their family the opportunity to dream big
As they raised children in a world and language they didn’t know, cleaned hospitals and served as cooks, they also built community – not just to maintain the traditions of home, but to fight and organize against injustice together.
Today, because of their sacrifices, I now have the honor of serving as the first Filipino, and the first AANHPI woman, to lead the California Democratic Party as Executive Director.
And I could not be prouder that, in this role, I get to carry on their legacy.
That’s not something I take lightly. Growing up, I never saw people who looked like us in positions of political leadership or power.
And now, every single day, I get to help lead the largest state Democratic Party in the country at one of the most important moments in our nation’s history.
I’ve had the privilege of helping elect Democrats up and down the ballot, serving as California Deputy State Director on the Harris-Walz campaign, working for Senator Kamala Harris, and helping build a strong bench of Democratic women leaders as Executive Director of Emerge California.
At every step, I’ve seen firsthand what organizing as a unified community can accomplish. In fact, it’s exactly what my grandparents set out to do as they founded Filipino American organizations in the Bay Area in the 1960s.
I’ve seen volunteers turn hopeless races into victories. I’ve seen intersectional communities come together to protect fundamental rights and freedoms. And I’ve seen people step up in extraordinary moments because they believed our democracy – our humanity – was worth fighting for.
This spirit is what inspires me at CADEM today. Especially in the hard moments.
We simply cannot afford to let Trump and Republicans take that away – there is too much at stake for our communities.
California has always led the way forward. Not because change happens on its own, but because California Democrats organize for it. We fight for it. We believe in something bigger than ourselves, just like our grandparents and ancestors have done for generations before us.
That’s why I’m proud to be a California Democrat. And it’s why I’m so grateful to be in this fight alongside you – like me, I know you’re also bringing with you the spark that those before you ignited within you.
If you’re able to, I hope you’ll consider making a contribution to support the California Democratic Party’s work across the state — in the name of hope, justice, and humanity. No pressure, I mostly just wanted to tell you a little bit more about myself, who inspires me, and thank you for being part of this movement. CHIP IN $ >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cdp-may26?&refcode=&amount=]Thank you again for being here and listening to a piece of my family’s story. It truly means a lot.
Salamat Po,
Melanie V. Ramil
Executive Director
California Democratic Party &
Proud Granddaughter of Alfonso and Vivencia Vanderlipe & Quintin and Fausta Ramil

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]
Friends, the White House’s latest political stunt was built around one of the GOP’s favorite buzzwords: fraud.
Today, Vice President JD Vance held a roundtable on fraud with a group of Republican state attorneys general.
He invited those Republican AGs more than a week ago — but Democratic AGs didn’t get the same treatment. Instead, we got a disingenuous, last-minute invitation late Friday afternoon.
No Democratic AG attended — because we won’t be used as props in Vance’s political performance.
(And if there was any doubt this wasn’t a good-faith effort, consider this: the head of my office's Medicaid Fraud Control Unit went to DC and showed up at the roundtable despite the late notice — and was actually turned away at the door.)
No matter what Trump and Vance want people to think, this just isn’t a partisan issue.
Fraud affects every state and every community. I’m proud that Democratic AGs are going after it with the full force of our offices, recovering billions in taxpayer dollars, securing convictions, and implementing reforms to strengthen our programs — because we don't need a White House invitation to do our jobs.
Here are just a few highlights of my office’s longstanding work to eradicate fraud:
California DOJ’s Division of Medi-Cal Fraud and Elder Abuse is on the ground every day, investigating and prosecuting fraudsters who steal from patients, seniors, and taxpayers. Just last month, we dismantled a massive hospice fraud operation in Los Angeles County that defrauded Medi-Cal of $267 million — the largest hospice fraud bust in state history.
In the last 10 years, we’ve conducted more than 2,300 criminal investigations related to fraud, filed charges against 958 individuals, and recovered more than $2.8 billion in state funds.
That's what real fraud enforcement looks like.
The reality is, fraudsters and scam artists operate in every state in the country — looking to make an easy buck off taxpayers’ backs. But instead of working with us to root out fraud and protect taxpayers, Trump and Vance have decided to gaslight the American people and exploit the issue to score political points.
No matter what partisan games the White House plays, I will never back down from holding anyone who targets our state systems accountable to the fullest extent of the law.
If you want to support our efforts to wipe out fraud and waste across California, will you make a contribution today to help power this work? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

DONATE $500 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?express_lane=true&amount=500] OTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]
With your help, we’ll keep doing this important work to tackle fraud the same way we always have: heads down, sleeves rolled up, and laser-focused on delivering results.
And if the federal government ever decides to quit playing games, we’ll be here — ready and willing to join forces to tackle fraud.
Thank you for your support.
—Rob

# [Legislative Comparison](https://bethfarnhamforcongress.com/2026/05/26/legislative-comparison/?jetpack_skip_subscription_popup)
---
By **Elizabeth Farnham** on May 26, 2026
---
| Many voters might wonder how my votes would compare to those of Representative Joyce.

Every week I send out a newsletter and if you scroll to the bottom, you will see this legislative comparison.

In it, you will find the columns that include name of the bills, how Joyce voted, if the bill passed the U.S. House of Representatives or not, how I would have voted, and my brief rationale for my vote on that bill. I have linked the bills to their actual text for your convenience.

FYI – if you’re having trouble seeing this comparison in your email, please click the option for “Read on Blog” and it will load properly for you.
---

Peter,
He called organizations like ours "leftist terror cells." Now Ken Paxton is one step closer to the U.S. Senate.
Tonight, Ken Paxton defeated John Cornyn in the Republican runoff. Let that sink in. The man who directed his office to “identify, investigate, and infiltrate” progressive organizations operating in Texas is now the Republican nominee for United States Senate.
He wasn’t talking about someone else. He was talking about us.
YES, I'll give monthly to fight back. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/texas-organizing-project-political-action-committee-3?refcode=TakingOnPaxton&amount=15.00&recurring=1]
This is not a drill. 🚨
“When Paxton ordered undercover investigations into organizations like TOP, he wasn’t just playing politics,” said Brianna Brown, Executive Director of the Texas Organizing Project. “He was sending a signal to every Black and Latino family in this state: you don’t belong here, and we will come for you if you organize. We’ve been called worse by people with less power. And we are still here. But make no mistake: this moment demands everything we have. A Paxton Senate seat is a direct threat to voting rights, immigrant communities, reproductive freedom, and the organizing infrastructure we've spent years building. We cannot sleepwalk into November.”
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/texas-organizing-project-political-action-committee-3?refcode=TakingOnPaxton&amount=15.00&refcode2=5648e92e-7859-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/texas-organizing-project-political-action-committee-3?refcode=TakingOnPaxton&amount=15.00&refcode2=5648e92e-7859-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c]
We have been here before. Targeted. Surveilled. Underestimated.
We are still organizing, still turning out the voters the political establishment writes off.
Still building the multi-racial, community power that keeps people like Paxton up at night. That’s exactly why he’s coming for us.
Will you rush a contribution to help us fight back at the ballot box this midterm?
I'll make a one-time gift right now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/texas-organizing-project-political-action-committee-3?refcode=TakingOnPaxton&amount=15.00]
He picked this fight. We intend to finish it.
If you can, set up a monthly gift today [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/texas-organizing-project-political-action-committee-3?refcode=TakingOnPaxton&amount=15.00&recurring=1] and make your support automatic. We need to know we can count on you through November.

body:
This is it. The final stretch is officially here.

| |
---
| | Peter, seven days. One week until CA-40 decides whether we move forward with courage and new leadership, or stay stuck with the same MAGA politicians who’ve spent years failing working families. This campaign has already blown me away. We started with no political machine. No billionaire backing. No built-in advantage.
Now we’re seven days away from pulling off something people said was impossible. [**If you can chip in $5 to help us power through this final week, I’d be incredibly grateful.**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/jKqGwPsQmV4BdlOIptvezg~~/AAUS1hA~/OlDEJ6n0Q2W0UQORgYz9KDNCcMtkG4Xc4T6i7_qg1gvKeN4gvLLlKNSHVjN1WjoQ-RzTCaDW29ku9viy0KRZdSz3KogVpyLw7TVLbqhwkf-AKS_RRAsQ3DG8CrP4ro6mHuvTI778t79an9B3BEyyXF96BD324JvJqktT4CAPvjcAJIIkNyWeBU4piUpcnIkTA5AuP9E5Y86BlQLtt9k6lsBj7ARMCMk0HV0wGh41bUw~) | | [PRESS TO DONATE](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/jKqGwPsQmV4BdlOIptvezg~~/AAUS1hA~/OlDEJ6n0Q2W0UQORgYz9KDNCcMtkG4Xc4T6i7_qg1gvKeN4gvLLlKNSHVjN1WjoQ-RzTCaDW29ku9viy0KRZdSz3KogVpyLw7TVLbqhwkf-AKS_RRAsQ3DG8CrP4ro6mHuvTI778t79an9B3BEyyXF96BD324JvJqktT4CAPvjcAJIIkNyWeBU4piUpcnIkTA5AuP9E5Y86BlQLtt9k6lsBj7ARMCMk0HV0wGh41bUw~)
---
These next seven days are going to be intense.
1. More TV ads.
2. More attacks.
3. More mailers.
4. More noise.

But we have something stronger: people.

body:
I’m honored
| It’s official, family.

**I’m proud to stand before you as your Democratic nominee in the U.S Senate race for Kentucky.** [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/109919?t=6&akid=24505%2E878179%2EResqMw) First, I cannot thank you enough for putting your trust and faith in our movement. I know you’re tired. I know you’re sick of politicians ignoring our communities.

**This is a declaration of regular people from forgotten places who feel like the government has turned away from them.** Because the people of Kentucky have spoken, and I’m ready to roll up my sleeves and fight harder than ever for the future of our Commonwealth.

I’m fighting for livable wages, Medicare for All, affordable housing, a Working People's Bill of Rights, and ending forever wars.

I’m fighting for my daughters’ future, our children, and YOU.

**Now, we’re racing toward the general election. That means our work to flip this seat starts _now._ We’re going to run away with it, but only if we do it together.**

Hello Friend, In a world filled with noise, confusion, and constant pressure, many people are searching for something that feels increasingly rare. A sense of peace that actually lasts. If you have ever wondered what the Bible really says about living a meaningful and fulfilled life, you are not alone. One of the most powerful teachings of Jesus is called the Beatitudes. If you have never heard that term before, you are not alone there either.

| | The Beatitudes are a short collection of statements Jesus made about what it truly means to be "blessed." But His definition may surprise you. He said those who are humble, those who show mercy, even those who are struggling can experience a kind of life that is deeply meaningful and secure. That is very different from what most of us have been taught.

## Iran Threatens US Over New Strikes
U.S. forces [carried out strikes](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHSpCAQhJ9GMywW0dGA4BKzvfRCi4XRnTuELZhdzrf_y_8V_rS7uqu__nNf75YCxf23PdDwltaItQRkxrxStrFUmyPF_WX_c4qVYrHRr0qqUchBKFi9pXCuuvVmQ1TYt2huAPMEowZon0ah1PM4PObRawVyUtpCP_hJAXjda9eSudrkoOAmJQxD5-Wop0FqcM5OEm6NluiJU-7-Jor8xC2c6YO5c-log3kyv0rT_2rU0qil1trFh7soLv9SUg6-UctF06jlXcRBgdjmUxR7FuFS9G_H6EXBsAmPG8aConCmf1gE27wjF3HFRXbR9nqc-rnNxr8qhUBlhEbL_bAUvhfxj278GPUVAAD__7COiDo) in southern Iran on Monday, hitting missile launch sites and Iranian boats accused of laying mines in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran called the strikes a clear violation of the seven-week ceasefire and threatened retaliation. Iran's Supreme Leader, Mojtaba Khamenei, said American military bases in the Middle East are [no longer safe](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO3CAURb8Gd4wwBp63oEjjbtOmtJ7N8_glGCxgx_HfR5Nf2PpK9-icX5_zJ3Lk9PyJB_m25TnRVSO1RmXmgqleWBKn54l_W04Xp4opzFppJ5WVGuaAHO_ZdMFvRJqGjnwP8DGCMwDd7gEWADWsGvU20GIGdMvQrwMGhW61rmP_flNWQ68UWPsIypnRKgPriqOCXhhFgVsuj9-ZU9tpi3d-UXms-eii31s7qxh-CD0JPbWddo7xvQk9nTnyegs9cWpUEjbOCaPQkx0_jDNWvhVl_ToLHSQjYaAiv6o8OHLDcssFK8naCv-hKvTUFR_Oi2Pk6kAY9TyQ_7O69q14L6__BQAA___x0YTA), in a message marking the start of the Hajj, the annual Muslim pilgrimage to Mecca. Despite the tensions, Secretary of State Marco Rubio said it could take "a few more days" to [finalize a deal](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGurCAURb9GOwwyIFpQvMZuXvtKg3AYzxtEw2GGO39_4_2F261kJyt773_35W4xYnr8tTuYEo4lQaUIpUBeMNtE1eaE6XHar3Kkiols8ovgYmBcMaEXbzF-Ftl6EwAE3FowvdbTqAepdbsZp7jTMKneifEWJsmDc9O4Bhk0DKtYWzSXjSuhe861Up3ngxwVl9o5O3LdN5KDx3Lk7v-BqWwQ4ud4Q-7csbfRbKWc1Nz-NGJuxFxr7Vxa3RU2Yr7UjZi5uviiFzF3JP9yhRhBDMxDgETAqGR8AjFM7NrNLLGSX_vJCOBJ7ATrgHmwsdvKHtts_FkxRqRBN5I_dovxp1D51YtvI74DAAD___V9hwQ), as negotiators continue to work through specific language. President Trump is set to convene a [rare Camp David](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOtCAUBeCn0Q6DiOIUFH9jN3-7pbkDV-duEAgwMvP2G_cVtj7JyfnO1329Azny-384UJctrB5rdlgKppUS-FwhefJ7hHcJvpLP4O0quJgYH5lQqwVyn1W2Vm-IAocWda_UbVaTVKp9auyFwNs2j7dZyW0wZuACRovDNqB8yKklfbXxUaieczWOneWTnEculTEwc9U3kqOlElL3HciXJ27uE05MnQlH6_SzlJib4V8jlkYstdZuC-9LceWNWGJwVMjkRiwlvY7ITPAneswsQUJm4IjMwkmWGXiQx8IOxEJ-Z5efWQTHYsKcXwnZnkLNbdI2VnKO8qQayfcDyP2uKX-68NTiJwAA__89z4kf) Cabinet meeting today to discuss next steps in the Iran talks.
## Trump's Redistricting Push Stalls in Two States
President Trump's effort to redraw congressional districts hit two setbacks Tuesday after South Carolina's Senate [rejected a Republican plan](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3CAUhJ8Gd1gY8-NbUKRxd9OmtFg42CdiwYKTdfbtI-8rpJpipE_fzK_v7dtjxrL_9E9wlOpW4OoZiKBt2Hzpl28Fy376v1TLhaX7EjcppOFCc2m36DG_NzVElwAkzAO4ydqvxRpl7XA4paZHBKWDNkabZbKzTVMUYbbC6NmmAd1NE1raSQir9RiFUYsWyobgF2EnpgREpNrG3xULHZDyu76gjaE-h-wOorOz-QeTK5PrdV1jeYR7xd0zuZ41I2HoTK4fbcgQCGthcu31Dx08-FYzFt95g4idGgbCsnNIqTbiyWPuvJMn4B3KHXs9eT3P2vEG8RaKn5X5MnJoLp4X5ozdWKbE_vSYP570X-e-nPwXAAD___f7kIM) to oust longtime Rep. Jim Clyburn, D-S.C. Also, on Tuesday, a federal court [blocked Alabama](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO4yAQhJ_G7mxhjFlcUFzjLtdeaW1g4-wJQwRcuLz9L_-v8HcjzWhG8_257TfkwPH4jSfZ-kh7pFYC1Up554yxNMyR4_HC_zXFxrFg9LsUUg9iGSTsHjl8dtV7-yCSNPdkJ4DVgFYA_dPSfNeTEzOSmYxRhKtzDjWCUStoWHu2V5tYJExCwLKMXmhlFqHAOTQCpk4J8lxTHv8mjvVJj_BJb8qjS2cf7LPWV-nmX53cOrm11kZ3L9eLy-_kdslObi79y3XAgHc8cXApHplK4RQxDJ5LzezqcLKvlM8r32frX41D4KKhU-I4kcP3ZP0Rp7eVXwEAAP__DE5-jw) from using a state-drawn map for the midterms, ruling it relied too heavily on race by including only one majority-black district. Alabama Attorney General Steve Marshall said he'd [appeal the ruling](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3S2yAURJ9G6tAgzI9cUKRR57QpNdfiIl8HgQawsd8-o7zCV-_Ozp7z57bcgALF7TfsaKtPS8RWAtaKeaEMsTTIkeJ2wKem2CgWiG4RXGjGFRNmcUDhu8jeWY8o8NKjHY25TkZLY_qHRT8q7YxWUkwInHN19SDuQruLmbzyPdlzjSthRs6NUoPjWk6KS7OuMHEzdpKjo5ry8EwU6wN9-KY35mFNex_so9ajdJdfnZg7MbfWBp8-J8WZd2I-UqBKa-nE7NFhhsCeL7chu4e0_i0MAtxhB5bRUamZ1kpxY0eAeDYaq_m1H3227mgUAhVtOsm3HSj8P1B_ZO1txb8AAAD__xmDhAE) to the Supreme Court, where a recent decision made it harder to challenge congressional maps as racially discriminatory. Both parties are racing to [redraw districts](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGS3CAQBNCvkTJUCIFYBQROlJ1Th6oRjLRjo0EF3OH7e9fuLzjuqq7X_etj-wCKxOdPuNDVI22MrUSsFfNGGbg0yEx83vC3Jm7EBThsSqpZSCOU3QJQ_N50H9yBqHDq0Y3WLg87a2v7pzO73rX2Si5gjh0WNU7BmsUuMgQ5m6kn92qTRtlRSmvMEOSsH0Zq6z08pB07LTFQTXn4nYjrE4_4nb4wDz5dfXTPWu_STT86tXZqba0NvPvXilfeqfVOkSr50qn1zcaIvlLiTq0HBswQhU-fuYo9Jv-nCIiwwwXisxCf4ky3CBkaC5_4zFgKJYYoLrhF9gyTnpfR9tmFu1GMVGbbaXleQPHtq_916pdT_wIAAP__cTyNGg) ahead of November, with Democrats picking up new seats from California and Utah and Republicans gaining ground in Texas, Florida, and several other states.
## Ferrari's First EV Falls Flat with Fans
Ferrari shares tumbled more than 5% Tuesday after the Italian sports car maker [unveiled the Luce](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFvwyAQBeBfg7dY-Iw5MjB08ZauHS0M5-QqAhFGof73lfsXuj3pSZ_03tdtuTmOnO6f7km2bnlJ1PZItVJZuLi0N1cSp_vL_dScGqfdpbCABH2R0wVwCY7jsagu2I0IaOzIDohXg1ohdg97HVEDKE0IjowZ9CgNmG1b3Tqsfhw7tqcmJ8BBSpymPkitzCQVeu-MxEEoSYFrLv135lQftMUjv6n0Pj-7aB-1vnYxfgiYBcyttX5d_dkJmM8xAmZXKvtIZ_TtACghHFPKXbHh1ThG3jUKJe9Px_FPrf-64m3hNwAA__9HRXJD), its first all-electric vehicle and a sharp departure from its signature design language. The five-seater, designed by former Apple designer Jony Ive, hits 60 mph in 2.5 seconds and features an external speaker system that amplifies the hum of the electric engine to give it more of a Ferrari-style roar. [Watch the reveal here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFq6zAUxvGnkbcYWZZ8nEHDhUugQwqZCl3MsXQcnyJLxlai5u2L-wpdvw9-w__jOlyRA8f7Oy5k85SGSGUPlDNtA28Y94Jb5Hhf8TunWDjuGP2gpOpO0pwUDB45vAZdeTsRKWorsg3AuYdOA1SzNUZNejTonId-Onsnm5ZGQt2ChNG7iu2hSaOgkRKMqb3sdG-kBuewl9AILclzTlv9lTjmmabwSk_aapeWKtg553UX7T-hLkJdSin1Kz3yY6TjPxbMbhbt5Sna_1P_GGH5vK23t2qzfi0cAu8dCC3vC3L4JfOfOjyt-gkAAP__5xRyDA). Critics on social media [called the design](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOozAQhp_GdBMZx2BSUFxDt9deiWbxkMzGjCOPNxxvf-JeYbtP-qVPv74_H_MHcmK5_8aNxrrmWWjXRLVSmbmg6I5FWO4v_Fuz7CyKEmdnXQ-2AxfmiJyO2TdxXIkcXRsa2xBuQ-h9CM1jxM9wc8vQdsEObm39Em9rG27UOn8d0HUNj6fNdi601oauu0Tb-6GzPiwLDja0xluKXHO5fGWW-qA1HflN5bLkrUnjo9aXmusv4ybjJjleWes5GTedYuMm25180ue3spCqcdNKpWBhBaEdem-fQImWWniBBQtgKoTxAIQNVflNsCInQImQcn4qfH1rhcRPAoSrfYKwKgpsWbSWrFwP46amjPG1c0qsfTDe3jfk9P93_VHs9-j-BQAA__8DMZOF) a "monstrosity" and compared it to a Nissan Leaf, which starts at around $30,000. Rivals Lamborghini and Porsche have [scaled back EV plans](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO4yAQhJ_G7rAwwcYpKK5Jl2uvtDawOHsiYC0kxG9_8r3CX440Gs33_bmvd6BIafsNL7Q15DVhKxFrRV6JIZUGnChtO3xrTo1SgeRXJdUs5CSUWT1QPFbdexsQFV56tKMx18XM2pj-aUEtMqDXI3qvF-dnH2bnpTPmcn1IMD3Zc01OyoxSmmkavJz1MkltnINFmrHTEj3VzMPfTKk-McQjf5AHl199tM9a99JdfnXq1qlba20I-ft4F0pYytnp1C3krzjBBLxrPjMyA5Ng_CDEIgJxqSK8YzwERnSVyQkHLPBAsed9p7SJncmhqLD1bP3eKEYqs-m03F5A8f-b-iOFH6v-BQAA__8Q_om6) due to weak demand for high-end electric cars.

## Paxton Defeats Cornyn in Runoff
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton defeated four-term incumbent Sen. John Cornyn in the [Republican Senate primary runoff](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LESnCAQBuCn0W4dQMWzoEhjd2lTOiiLkiAwsHfq22fu8gipd2b___t_Peendt6F7ac-UNFl4xzwLB6JMM9JXxTD6UIhxLA4IgzLXXY9CyYksB7EMBvt_D13tVELMyOvUfFhGB_D-OCy3lXHRtPKkdtVsGU1bLQr9rxbrJX80XOsnfo8Y70YOGdt2zeSYyeGth9bLSSXrOoYGkcxN7Qj4aWL9Xd8Y27WeNRe7USpVO2PSkyVmM7zbGy8PorPvRJTit6RW0slpkNvGii715F2oPw6Emjvb_iDAf5hwaBFTQV-xz3AGnO4A3zlGb7ZsMUEKbtD5xtOneusTDqd967IoerYdmjnv83o__Z8K_E3AAD__9CDjmo) on May 26, winning roughly 62% to 38%.
